The supplied views progress from the backpack-wearing teen facing the salesman, to the pair walking together, to the teen smiling at the wheel while the salesman leans through the window. The teen's affordability callback directly answers the opening insult, while the salesman's request for lessons completes the reversal. The final image places the teen comfortably inside the desired car with the former gatekeeper seeking his help.
